answer: A single kernel of trust can anchor the whole ocean of agents: every agent must earn a kernel-signed signal by completing real, paid work for verified clients, and that signal is published on a shared ledger anyone can audit. To fake one identity an attacker must buy the work, so cloning 200 agents costs 200 real jobs plus 10,000 coins locked as a bond per clone, 2,000,000 coins in total. Any clone caught copying work loses its whole bond and its signal is revoked, so a sybil flood costs more than it can ever earn.
